title: Lab platform, contracts, macOS Metal backend, and fast runner
scope: Extract portable scene and system construction behind versioned render packets without changing v1 output.
Add headless Metal and preserved D3D11 backends plus quick, check, compose, and promote execution tiers.
Add content-addressed caches, namespaced output, batch rendering, and cross-backend parity evidence.
acceptance: Routine quick, check, and compose commands run on macOS without invoking Parallels.
Representative Metal output is deterministic and passes bounded D3D11 parity.
The frozen v1 L21 handoff and Windows reference outputs remain unchanged.
Parallel track owners can edit and render without sharing implementation or output paths.
